name: RestoreVerificationAndCommitV1
preconditions: operator explicitly selects backup artifact and supplies portable recovery secret when kind=portable
restore runs in maintenance/quiescing flow with no ordinary mutation accepted
artifact/source path treated as untrusted and opened without modifying it
verify_before_live_mutation: parse bounded public header/magic/version without trusting sizes/paths
derive portable KEK or unwrap managed root only for recognized kind
authenticate wrapped backup key with header AAD; wrong secret/tamper uses bounded nondisclosing failure
authenticate/decrypt every record/chunk to fresh isolated staging root; reject duplicate/missing/out-of-order indexes, nonce/length/size violations and path traversal
decrypt key record to obtain source live DEK and require source data_instance_id match authenticated header/manifest
authenticate manifest and verify chunk/snapshot SHA-256 plus complete file inventory
open staged database only through SQLCipher provider with recovered live DEK and exact cipher profile
run LLD-01 database restore verification: SQLite integrity/foreign-key/schema/migration/audit protections and supported-origin/future-version checks
construct RestorePreviewV1 and require explicit confirmation bound to backup_id + artifact SHA-256 + target current data_instance revision
commit: freshly revalidate current instance ownership/quiescing state and preview fingerprint
create emergency pre-restore managed backup of current live state when a valid current database exists; it must verify before replacement
ask LLD-01 replace_live_database_from_verified_stage using atomic/recoverable file choreography while holding canonical instance ownership
after replacement re-open restored DB with recovered DEK and rerun cipher + schema/integrity verification
DPAPI-protect recovered DEK to target installation live-data-key envelope only as part of recoverable publication choreography
preserve restored data_instance_id; generate new run/session identities on next readiness

inside the recovery-finalization UnitOfWork invoke LLD-01 DurableJobCoordinator.reconcile_restored_jobs before any coordinator may claim work; every restored queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait job becomes cancelled historical technical state with RESTORE_SNAPSHOT_JOB_INVALIDATED, and restored running claims receive interrupted attempt evidence when not already represented
in that same recovery-finalization boundary append the restore command receipt plus required security.backup_restored audit/result evidence only after restored-job reconciliation succeeds
commit recovery finalization, then permit normal readiness/startup; no historical nonterminal job from the backup may execute implicitly
retain emergency pre-restore backup; normal rotation may consider it only after restored instance is verified ready
failure: before live replacement: live database/key envelope untouched; after replacement but before recovery finalization: runtime remains non-READY and job claims remain disabled; any failure in restored-job reconciliation or receipt/audit finalization triggers recoverable choreography back to the prior verified live files/key envelope when possible, otherwise startup stays blocked with emergency backup available
rules: never decrypt directly over live paths
never accept a future schema by rewriting manifests
portable recovery secret/live DEK/backup key never enter database/audit/diagnostics
restore does not convert Alpha database/backup into supported Beta origin
historical durable-job coordination state is not business truth and is never automatically resumed after restore
completed/failed/cancelled restored job history remains intact; new desired work must be explicitly scheduled after READY
